# Ezekiel 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-was in-the-sixth year, in-the-sixth [month], on-the-fifth of-the-month — I [was] sitting in-my-house, and-the-elders-of Judah [were] sitting before-me — and-the-hand-of the-Lord YHWH fell upon-me there.

**2** And-I-saw, and-behold, a-likeness like-[the]-appearance-of fire — from-the-appearance-of His-waist and-downward, fire; and-from-His-waist and-upward, like-[the]-appearance-of brightness, like-[the]-gleam-of amber.

**3** And-He-stretched-out [the]-form-of a-hand and-took-me by-a-lock-of my-head, and-the-spirit lifted-me between the-earth and-between the-heavens, and-brought-me to-Jerusalem in-visions-of God, to-the-entrance-of the-gate-of the-inner [court], the-one-facing north, where [was] the-seat-of the-image-of jealousy, the-one-provoking-jealousy.

**4** And-behold, there [was] the-glory-of the-God-of Israel, like-the-vision which I-saw in-the-valley.

**5** And-He-said to-me, "Son-of man, lift, please, your-eyes [toward the]-way-of [the]-north." And-I-lifted my-eyes [toward the]-way-of [the]-north, and-behold, to-the-north of-the-gate-of the-altar, this image-of jealousy at-the-entrance.

**6** And-He-said to-me, "Son-of man, do-you-see what they [are]-doing — abominations great which the-house-of Israel [is]-doing here, to-go-far from-upon My-sanctuary? And-yet-again you-will-see abominations great."

**7** And-He-brought-me to the-entrance-of the-court, and-I-looked, and-behold, a-hole-one in-the-wall.

**8** And-He-said to-me, "Son-of man, dig, please, in-the-wall." And-I-dug in-the-wall, and-behold, an-entrance-one.

**9** And-He-said to-me, "Go-in and-see the-abominations, the-evil-ones, which they [are]-doing here."

**10** And-I-went-in and-saw, and-behold, every form-of creeping-thing and-beast, detestable-things, and-all the-idols-of the-house-of Israel, engraved upon-the-wall all-around, all-around.

**11** And-seventy men from-[the]-elders-of the-house-of Israel, and-Jaazaniah son-of Shaphan standing in-their-midst — [were]-standing before-them, and-each his-censer in-his-hand, and-the-fragrance-of the-cloud-of the-incense [was]-going-up.

**12** And-He-said to-me, "Have-you-seen, son-of man, what the-elders-of the-house-of Israel [are]-doing in-the-darkness, each in-the-rooms-of his-imagery? For they-say, 'YHWH does-not-see-us; YHWH has-forsaken the-land.'"

**13** And-He-said to-me, "Yet-again you-will-see abominations great which they [are]-doing."

**14** And-He-brought-me to the-entrance-of the-gate-of the-house-of YHWH which [is] toward-the-north, and-behold, there the-women sitting, weeping-for the-Tammuz.

**15** And-He-said to-me, "Have-you-seen, son-of man? Yet-again you-will-see abominations greater than-these."

**16** And-He-brought-me to the-inner court-of the-house-of YHWH, and-behold, at-the-entrance-of the-temple-of YHWH, between the-porch and-between the-altar, about twenty-five men, their-backs to-the-temple-of YHWH and-their-faces toward-the-east, and-they [were]-bowing-down eastward to-the-sun.

**17** And-He-said to-me, "Have-you-seen, son-of man? Is-it-a-light-thing for-the-house-of Judah to-do the-abominations which they-do here? For they-have-filled the-land [with]-violence and-they-return to-provoke-Me; and-behold-them putting the-branch to-their-nose.

**18** And-I also will-act in-fury; My-eye shall-not-spare, and-I-will-not-have-pity; and-they-will-cry in-My-ears [with a]-voice great, and-I-will-not-hear-them."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **8:3**: Semel ha-qin'ah ha-maqneh — 'image of jealousy, the provoking one.' Likely an Asherah pole or pagan statue placed at the Temple entrance. YHWH's 'jealousy' (qin'ah) is covenantal — He tolerates no rival.

- **8:14**: Ha-Tammuz — the Mesopotamian fertility deity whose annual 'death' was mourned in ritual weeping. Israelite women participating in this cult at YHWH's Temple is the height of syncretism.

- **8:16**: Twenty-five men with backs to the Temple facing east to worship the sun — a deliberate turning away from YHWH. The number may represent the 24 priestly divisions plus the high priest.

— EMET
